data.title: points made by agent dog fooding init in different project: 1. The README says npm i -D tuhdoo. pnpm add -D worked identically, but a pnpm/yarn line would help — pnpm users hit the "does it handle os/cpu optional deps" question, and it does. 2. tuhdoo init --help errors with unexpected argument "--help" instead of printing usage. Minor, but --help on a subcommand is muscle memory.
